description: Not in the call format: steps over a transcript made of session-rewind-fixture.json's records (`copies` times, uuids suffixed with -<copy> past the first, the first `lines` lines of it, each JSON text and a newline), read by projection caches (`cache`: a name, a new name a fresh cache, as another process) with a cursor (`cursor`: an earlier step's, by its `as`), and what agent_history.get answers: mode, cursor, base_revision, the ids of entries or upserts, removed and order. Read by server/src/agent/history-cursor.test.ts (HISTORY_CURSOR_RECORD=1 records the answers) and by roamgate-agents' history_cursor_tests.rs, so both give the same cursor for the same file.
